Terrace_A.name: SM_Age4_Terrace_A
Terrace_A.notes: Plot = front steps + main block + rear outshots + walled yards with privies. Rows butt end to end along X (the end walls are party walls); back-to-back rows meet at the yard walls.

Terrace_B.name: SM_Age4_Terrace_B
Terrace_B.notes: Plot = front steps + main block + rear outshots + walled yards with privies. Rows butt end to end along X (the end walls are party walls); back-to-back rows meet at the yard walls.

Terrace_C.name: SM_Age4_Terrace_C
Terrace_C.notes: Plot = front steps + main block + rear outshots + walled yards with privies. Rows butt end to end along X (the end walls are party walls); back-to-back rows meet at the yard walls.

Terrace_D.name: SM_Age4_Terrace_D
Terrace_D.notes: Plot = front steps + main block + rear outshots + walled yards with privies. Rows butt end to end along X (the end walls are party walls); back-to-back rows meet at the yard walls.

Factory_A.name: SM_Age4_Factory_A
Factory_A.notes: Two-storey sawtooth mill, engine house, office, three stacks (the tallest elements, 46-58 m), water tower. SOCKET_Smoke_* on every stack for the smoke FX.

Factory_B.name: SM_Age4_Factory_B
Factory_B.notes: Single-storey sawtooth shed, boiler house, one 44 m stack.

Stack_A.name: SM_Age4_Stack_A
Stack_A.notes: 52 m tapered round brick chimney on a square plinth; SOCKET_Smoke_0 at the top.

Warehouse_A.name: SM_Age4_Warehouse_A
Warehouse_A.notes: Five-storey dock warehouse, double-pile roof, loading doors stacked under a projecting cathead with hoist.

Warehouse_B.name: SM_Age4_Warehouse_B
Warehouse_B.notes: Single-storey goods shed with rooflights, raised loading platform and canopy, siding track (rail top at Z = 0).

Station_A.name: SM_Age4_Station_A
Station_A.notes: Glass-and-iron barrel-vault train shed (32 m span) over four tracks and three platforms, front building with a clock tower and end pavilions. Tracks run along X and leave the footprint at both ends (rail top Z = 0, centre lines at local Y = 0.75, 9.25, 12.75, 21.25 before centring; see sockets-free track ends in the .blend).

MineHead_A.name: SM_Age4_MineHead_A
MineHead_A.notes: Steel lattice headframe with twin sheave wheels and back-stays, heapstead, winding engine house, boiler house and 34 m stack, ore bin. Pair with SM_Age4_Spoil_A.

Spoil_A.name: SM_Age4_Spoil_A
Spoil_A.notes: 44 x 34 m, 15 m high colliery tip with tipping track. Roof slot unused (same material as Structure).

Spoil_B.name: SM_Age4_Spoil_B
Spoil_B.notes: 14 x 11 m, 4 m high yard heap. Roof slot unused (same material as Structure).

Bridge_A.name: SM_Age4_Bridge_A
Bridge_A.pivot: deck centre at rail level; piers reach 16 m below the rails
Bridge_A.modular: segment pitch 43 m along X (40 m Pratt through-truss + a half pier at each end); chain copies at X + 43 m
Bridge_A.notes: Double-track iron through-truss; Ruin = span broken off one pier and tilted into the river.

Bridge_B.name: SM_Age4_Bridge_B
Bridge_B.pivot: deck centre at rail level; piers reach 16 m below the rails
Bridge_B.modular: segment pitch 36 m along X (three 9.6 m brick arches, half piers at the ends)
Bridge_B.notes: Brick arch viaduct for the approaches of the truss bridge or valley crossings.

Ornament_A.name: SM_Age4_Ornament_A
Ornament_A.notes: SM_Age4_Ornament_A (domed clay chimney cap); snaps to SOCKET_Ornament_* (pivot at its base).

Ornament_B.name: SM_Age4_Ornament_B
Ornament_B.notes: SM_Age4_Ornament_B (upswept timber gable horns); snaps to SOCKET_Ornament_* (pivot at its base).

Ornament_C.name: SM_Age4_Ornament_C
Ornament_C.notes: SM_Age4_Ornament_C (conical stone finial); snaps to SOCKET_Ornament_* (pivot at its base).

description: Industry age kit: brick terraces, factories and stacks, rail station, mine headframe, spoil heaps, warehouses, bridges.

conventions.axes: Z up, front -Y (Unreal +X after the standard FBX import)
conventions.pivot: footprint centre at ground level; bridges: deck centre at rail level

vertex_colour_Col.R: per-window random id: lit when R < instance LitFraction

conventions.night_windows: T_Age4_Trim_M channel R (emissive mask), G per-pane random
conventions.fbx: binary, LOD group (LOD0..LOD3), smoothing groups from 35 deg sharp edges, tangents, linear vertex colours, SOCKET_ empties under LOD0

ornaments.description: Culture ornament meshes snap to SOCKET_Ornament_* sockets (chimney tops, gable apexes, the station spire).
ornaments.material: M_Age4_Trim (single Detail slot) or its culture instance
